title: Kanban Board
subtitle: Kanban view of all agents by status
subtitleSessions: Kanban view of all sessions by status
noAgentsDesc: Start a monitored agent session with hooks installed to see agents appear here.
noSessionsDesc: Start a monitored agent session with hooks installed to see sessions appear here.

agent.working:
Agent is actively processing work right now.

It moves back to Waiting when this turn ends.
agent.waiting:
Agent finished its turn or needs a human response, such as permission approval.

It returns to work when the session continues.
agent.completed:
Agent has fully ended for this session.

No further activity will be recorded against this agent.
agent.error: Agent recorded an error and will not continue until the session is resumed or retried.

session.active: Session is mid-turn — an agent is currently working and the user is not blocking anything. This state is brief: the session returns to Waiting when the turn ends.
session.waiting:
Session is waiting on you. A turn may have completed, or the agent may need permission or input.

Look here for sessions you owe a reply to.
session.completed:
Session has fully closed because its CLI exited cleanly or it was explicitly closed.

All agents on this session are also completed.
session.error: Session ended with an error — an unrecoverable failure or an upstream API error terminated the run.
session.abandoned: Session went stale without a clean exit signal. Marked abandoned after 5+ minutes of no activity (for example after /resume, a network drop, or a killed CLI). Distinct from Completed: no real exit was observed.
